backend/main.mo: Defines core types, state maps, and comparison utilities for races, users, cars, teams, and holidays, with authorization mixin and initial admin logic.
feature_evidence.json: Reports feature evidence linking deployment-related files, components, and tests for publishing the game.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries for numerous frontend source files, describing their roles in the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS config defining theme variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint with cache-busting headers and script loading for the React frontend.
frontend/PUBLISH_RUNBOOK.md: Detailed deployment and verification guide outlining publish steps, smoke tests, troubleshooting, and rollback procedure.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all app routes, layouts, admin-guarded pages, and global providers.
frontend/src/assets/generatedAssets.ts: Exports static paths for generated asset packs like logos, cars, trails, and banners.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: UI component showing an access denied message with navigation back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAudit: Stub audit log component displaying sample admin actions inside a scrollable card.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Checks authentication and user profile before rendering admin content, showing loading or access-denied screens if requirements aren't met.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Displays a dialog prompting new authenticated users to create a profile and saves submitted data via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation, authentication handling, and conditional admin links.
frontend/src/components/race/carModelPro: Defines the CarModelProfile interface and several Lamborghini and Bugatti car profile constants with dimensional and visual properties.
frontend/src/components/race/CarViewer3D: Renders a 3D animated car model using react-three-fiber based on selected model and color.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackCarMar: Draws a small stylized top-down car marker for race tracks using model profile dimensions and color mapping.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackVisual: Visualizes race progress with lanes and animated car markers for the player and ghost opponents.
frontend/src/components/race/WordZoneInd: Shows the user's typing zone and target word count in either compact or detailed card form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActiveCar.ts: Manages the active car ID in localStorage with getter and setter helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin role checks and retrieves the caller's user role using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useEconomy.ts: Implements admin coin grants and a stubbed race completion mutation with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useGhostOpponents.ts: Returns disabled ghost opponent data with placeholders for future backend support.
frontend/src/hooks/useHolidays.ts: Contains disabled holiday fetch, add, and remove operations pending backend features.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, login, logout, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useInventory.ts: Fetches the current user's inventory based on their principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeaderboards.ts: Provides a disabled leaderboard query stub awaiting backend support.
frontend/src/hooks/useMotd.ts: Exposes a static message of the day placeholder with no backend connection.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides user profile, inventory, car catalog, and role-management queries and mutations using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeams.ts: Implements disabled team-related queries and mutations pending backend features.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and applying global styles.
frontend/src/lib/adminCommandParser.ts: Parses admin text commands into structured actions for creating titles, setting MOTD, adding text, or granting coins.
frontend/src/lib/raceMetrics.ts: Computes typing race metrics including WPM and accuracy based on character counts and time.
frontend/src/lib/raceTextGeneration.ts: Generates race text using word pools and WPM-based word zones, with helpers to store and retrieve effective WPM.
frontend/src/lib/wordZones.ts: Maps WPM ranges to word zones and selects appropriate target word counts for text generation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPag: Placeholder admin page for managing banner designs, showing a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarsPage.t: Placeholder admin page for managing cars, currently displaying a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarTemplat: Placeholder admin page for managing car templates with a coming-soon notice.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCustomizeI: Admin index page linking to different customization management sections such as cars, templates, banners, trails, nitros, and titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminEconomyToo: Admin interface for granting TRP Coins to users, validating input and showing economy-related info.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminHomePage.t: Admin dashboard showing navigation cards for all admin tools like texts, customization, economy, MOTD, user management, and assistant.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminManagement: UI for granting and revoking admin access via Principal IDs with validation and success/error handling.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMotdPage.t: Placeholder page for configuring the message of the day.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminNitrosPage: Placeholder page for future nitro effects management.
Placeholder interface for managing race texts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTitlesPage: Placeholder page for managing player titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTrailsPage: Placeholder page for managing trail effects.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUpdateAssi: Interface for parsing and executing natural-language admin commands, currently supporting TRP coin grants.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TextDemoPage.ts: Placeholder for testing race texts in a demo environment.
frontend/src/pages/CustomizePage.tsx: UI for customizing cars and other assets, loading user inventory and catalog data.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays welcome screen or user dashboard with profile, actions, and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardsPage.tsx: Renders placeholder leaderboards UI with category tabs for speed, accuracy, and combined rankings.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user profile page, showing identity-gated profile details and stats with loading and empty states. Displays user metrics like WPM, accuracy, and account creation date.
frontend/src/pages/RaceHistoryPage.tsx: Displays a login-gated placeholder page for race history, indicating the feature is not yet implemented. Shows a simple layout with upcoming functionality messaging.
frontend/src/pages/RaceLobbyPage.tsx: Provides the race lobby with mode selection, WPM-based word zone previews, and navigation into active races. Requires login and supports solo, ghost, and practice starts.
frontend/src/pages/RacePage.tsx: Runs the active typing race, generating text, tracking progress, computing metrics, and storing results for the results page. Handles animations, WPM/accuracy updates, and finish logic.
frontend/src/pages/RaceResultsPage.tsx: Displays stored race results including WPM, accuracy, and time, handling practice mode and unsaved results when not logged in. Redirects if no result data is available.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Implements the shop where users can view car catalog variants, preview colors, and purchase cars if logged in. Manages inventory checks, loading states, and purchase actions.
frontend/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx: Provides a system settings page with seasonal tabs and admin-only holiday management, including adding and removing holidays.
frontend/src/pages/TeamDetailsPage.tsx: Displays detailed information about a specific team, including membership, balance, and founder status, with conditional UI for members.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx: Lists all teams and allows users to create new teams if they have enough TRP Coins, with a dialog for entering the team name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for getting, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, layout, animations, and fonts for the project.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, existing and new feature requests, and versioning for a deployment-focused project.
